question: Which region witnessed the strongest violence and martial law enforcement during the Rowlatt Satyagraha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Punjab** witnessed the strongest violence during the **Rowlatt Satyagraha** due to widespread anger against the repressive Rowlatt Act enacted by the British government.
 
• The situation escalated significantly in **Amritsar**, where protests turned into violent confrontations between the people and British authorities.
 
• The infamous **Jallianwala Bagh Massacre** occurred on **13 April 1919** in Amritsar, where British troops under General Dyer fired upon a peaceful gathering, killing hundreds of innocent civilians.
 
• Martial law was imposed in Punjab, particularly in cities like **Amritsar** and **Lahore**, to suppress dissent and protests against the British regime.
 
• The Rowlatt Satyagraha marked a significant turning point in India's freedom struggle, galvanizing nationwide protests against British colonial rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rowlatt Act:**

 
 
• The **Rowlatt Act**, officially known as the **Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Act of 1919**, was passed by the British government to curb revolutionary activities.
 
• It allowed the government to arrest individuals without trial and suppress freedom of expression, which led to widespread resentment across India.
 
• The Act was seen as a betrayal of promises made during World War I, when Indians were assured greater autonomy in return for their support in the war.
